descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S11 Retention edges on the task view: Hospital completed 16 h and open 36 h after last processing, ±1 h; Nursing Home completed recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • G1 UAT 3.6 on the task view, Hospital: completed tasks leave 16 h after they were done; open tasks leave 36 h after the chart was last processed (Nursing Home open tasks persist: U6) (UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed) (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.6; TFA-92585 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Seeded Hospital patients and a Nursing Home resident whose tasks and processing stamps are back-dated from time:now at seed time

When Open the Hospital list (the context lifecycle runs on entry) → Task Export, expand the completed section; switch to Nursing Home → Task Export, expand the completed section

Then Hospital: the task completed 15 h ago is at the bottom, the one completed 17 h ago is gone; the open task on the chart processed 35 h ago is shown, the open task on the chart processed 37 h ago is gone. Nursing Home: the open task is shown; the two completed cells are recorded for Q4

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 Hospital windows (G1). s11-h-view: mustContain 'QA Hosp Ivy Chen', 'Repeat lactate', 'Arrange cardiology follow-up'; mustNotContain 'Recheck magnesium', 'Order outpatient sleep study'. Expected on main: the 37 h open-task cell fails because hospitalLifecyclePatch has no open-task clear — report it as a new Fail and raise it with Daniela, not as a known gap. …

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (back-dated doneAt/notesProcessedAt from time:now; lifecycle on entry or rounding:applyLifecycle)); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
